invariants: OutputSpec retains the author-declared path separately from the run-owned storage path and binds the latter to the former.
Resolved single-file and bundle artifacts retain the declared materialization path beside their immutable SnapshotFileRef values.
Stage resolution, download materialization, and verified reuse preserve the retained path without reconstructing it from storage layout.
Restoration joins a destination directory to the retained path and never parses SnapshotFileRef.path to recover author intent.
A resolved artifact without a retained path, or with a path that differs from its output declaration, is rejected.

findings.finding: The first fixture update reused the bundle-root parameter as the member-loop variable.
findings.repair: Use a distinct member_path variable and retain the declared bundle root unchanged.

findings.finding: The first schema draft did not bind OutputSpec.path to OutputSpec.relative_path.
findings.repair: Validate that the run-owned output path ends at the declared relative path and test the severed relationship.

findings.finding: The first expanded gate found protocol fixtures that still omitted the required path and two tests that changed only the run-owned path.
findings.repair: Migrate every serialized fixture and update both path fields when a test deliberately changes output identity.

mechanical_evidence.focused_result: Pyright reported 0 errors; 209 tests and 9 subtests passed in 216.84 seconds; Ruff formatting and lint checks passed.
mechanical_evidence.real_acceptance: The restore planner uses retained output paths even when the immutable storage filenames differ, and schema tests reject omitted or mismatched retained paths.
